prompt:
The young man of the first reference picture, with exactly his face and his
curly dark hair, stands on the grey granite pavement of the street shown in the
second reference picture, in the morning sun. He wears a plain white T-shirt
and blue jeans.

He is seen from the hips up, a little left of centre in a vertical frame. The
bottom edge of the picture crosses his jeans at the hips, and the top of his
head sits a hand's width under the top edge, so that his face is one of the
largest things in the picture.

On the left of the picture, at his shoulder and a little out of focus, is the
open rear of the small white car with its boot full of brown cardboard boxes
above a plain white bumper, and above it the ochre facade with its green door and wrought-iron balconies. His hand
nearer the car rests on the top of one of the boxes in the open boot; his
other arm hangs relaxed. His head is turned towards the right edge of the
picture, where someone stands beyond the frame, and he looks there with a
friendly, open face. The sun comes from the right of the picture and lights
his face.
